offer.text: The harvest is in and we're holding a feast — and you're guest of honour. Bring a cake to share and the table's complete.

accept.text: Wonderful! I'll set you a place by the fire.

decline.text: The offer stands whenever you're ready, friend.

in_progress.text: Is the cake on its way? Everyone's gathering.

ready.text: A cake fit for the whole village — come, sit!

complete.text: You're family now, plain and simple. Whatever you need, our door is open.
